title: Adjustable Respawn Immunity
description: Adds a respawn immunity over the existing one
body:
This datapack adds an easy to use adjustable respawn immnuity. It has a few options, however, it doesn't override the vanilla one. So if the datapack's respawn immunity is turned off/lower than 3 seconds, the vanilla one will still be there.

# Features
- An adjustable duration
- Fire Resistance (only to remove the visual effects of taking fire damage)
- Void Resistance
- Knockback Resistance
- An options menu
- First login immunity (currently not toggleable)

## How to use
- To access all of the options, enter _/function spwnprot:.options_ and click the buttons that have appeared in chat.

## Upcoming features
- Login immunity 
- A toggle for the first login immunity
